verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's documented automation surface is a CLI for retrieving secrets and managing vaults and items inside scripts and CI/CD pipelines. That is a building block a user could run from an external scheduler. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself scheduling recurring jobs or workflows, such as scheduled exports, rotations or scans, so the applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
